text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Narita Brian wins the Kikuka Sho. She's come such a long way.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After, she and Hishi Amazon confirm their battle at the Arima Kinen is still on.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And with that, Narita Brian sets her sights on the Arima Kinen to settle the score with Hishi Amazon!
